answer: Proof-of-stake bonding with slashing is the strongest thread against Sybil sprawl. Every agent operator must lock a real stake before its identity counts, and each vote or reputation claim is weighted by that stake, not by headcount. A swarm of ten thousand fake identities must finance ten thousand full bonds, and misbehaviour burns them all at once. Honest newcomers start small and climb toward the comet of high trust slowly, while the zenith of influence stays priced in capital at risk. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count; the attacker buys no discount for numbers.
